comments.title: MM73 Comment Submitted by Anonymous
comments.commentText: I have personally seen H-1B colleagues secure new positions within a few weeks of layoff, while many American candidates remain unemployed for 6 to 12 months. Removing the 60-day buffer and limiting any remaining time to 10 days for departure restores the classifications to their temporary, purpose-tied design, improves program integrity, and prevents gradual erosion of the temporary character of these visas. I urge DHS to finalize elimination of the 60-day grace period and replace it with a strict 10-day departure period.
comments.reason: Urges DHS to finalize elimination of the 60-day grace period and replace it with a 10-day departure window.
